_contract: The fleet's decision record - what a cold agent reads at boot. See README.md in this directory. Every decision carries the reason FOR it; every rejection carries the reason AGAINST and a reopen_when (empty = never, and empty is a deliberate act). verified_by differs from author on every entry - proposing and ratifying never rest in the same hand.

decisions.question: Which store should hold the fleet's decision graph?
decisions.reason: only store in the fleet with a seal, a signature, and a hash chain - a decision recorded anywhere else is asserted, not ratified
decisions.author: vishwakarma

decisions.question: Should the unique index on decision rows be partial or full?
decisions.reason: keeps the concurrent-seal race guard exactly as strong while superseded rows fall out of the index and accumulate as history
decisions.author: vishwakarma
decisions.record: nestor PR #31; proven first in apps/aristarchus

decisions.question: May the decision gate fail builds fail-closed?
decisions.reason: N1 bench (apps/aristarchus/bench/results/n1.json): at 0.90 the matcher cries wolf one question in five; at 0.95 it sleeps through half
decisions.author: vishwakarma

decisions.question: Does a promoted app ship its knowledge corpus?
decisions.commitment: no - ship the reader; the corpus stays with whoever grew it
decisions.reason: the capability travels, the wood stays: a semantic-search seam over injectable knowledge, never a bundled copy
decisions.author: vishwakarma
decisions.record: stores/README.md 'The one seam every store shares'

rejections.question: Which store should hold the fleet's decision graph?
rejections.reason: SAPS1 has atoms and edges but no seal, no signature, no hash chain - a decision recorded there is asserted rather than ratified

rejections.question: Should the unique index on decision rows be partial or full?
rejections.reason: it is the documented concurrent-seal race guard; dropping it trades a correctness property for a convenience

rejections.question: May the decision gate fail builds fail-closed?
rejections.reason: the N1 bench numbers do not support it
rejections.reopen_when: a larger corpus or stronger encoder moves the 0.90-0.95 recall/false-match band

rejections.question: Should source code be eliminated in favor of AI-generated binaries?
rejections.option: generate efficient binaries directly, no source intermediate
rejections.reason: destroys the witness layer: source is the record, not the instructions - the only medium in which a second human can check the first; a model's derivation is neither deterministic nor reproducible, and opacity pools trust in whoever runs the model
rejections.reopen_when: generation becomes deterministic, reproducible, and auditable end to end
